👨‍💻 Sabiway API Documentation - Posts (Admin)

Admin reference: Django Admin UI & API endpoints related to posts, hashtags, comments and replies.

Manage posts in Django admin.

Admin URL: /admin/posts/post/
List display: id, author, likes_count, comments_count, created_at
Readonly fields: likes_count, comments_count, impressions_count
Search fields: author__username, content

Manage hashtags in Django admin.

Admin URL: /admin/posts/hashtag/
List display: tag, use_count
Search fields: tag
Note: use_count is updated automatically when posts are created, edited, or deleted.
Admin URL: /admin/posts/comment/
List display: id, user, post, created_at
Admin URL: /admin/posts/reply/
List display: id, user, comment, created_at
